name: Poyopoyo Oppai Summer
original_name: ポヨポヨおっぱいさま～
source:
The summer of Japan is the summer of breasts!?

This is a comical story where a boyish girl and a huge-breasted woman who is expected to be a worldwide scientist in the future!
They fight over the protagonist, who happens to love big breasts above all!

Worried about her breast size, the girl decides to make her bust larger so that she can protect her beloved boy from the seduction of the scientist and make him her boyfriend!

translation:
日本的夏天是胸部的夏天！？

這是一個男孩子氣的女孩和前途看好的世界級巨乳女科學家的搞笑故事！
她們爭奪主角，而主角恰好最喜歡巨乳！

由於擔心自己的罩杯，女孩決定讓自己的胸圍變大，這樣她就可以保護她心愛的男孩免受科學家的誘惑，並讓他成為她的男朋友！
